steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: I was curious about who'd cracked the maze that guy built, rushing into here to court death. It's you, after all...

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: Makes sense, you've still got the shackles. It can help you cheat.
The moment it looks up, the Mania inside you explodes, almost knocking you to the ground. Farther away, the Corpseborne with Julien's face is perched on a throne, gazing down at you.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: You're so insignificant; I had almost forgot you existed... Had that architect not hidden you, you would've been my prey by now.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: What's with the silence? You were quite the talker last time. "It's not a hunting ground for a monster like you," you said, all high and mighty. Funny, you had so much to say then, but now, not a peep.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: Died once and learned your lesson, huh?

options: The shackles are starving, time to devour a Black Ring.
Rumor has it, there's a scaredy-cat hiding.

steps.content: Feels like there's someone more powerful on your trail; your time might be up.
I'm just here to watch and learn, curious about how the shackles handle a monster like you.
Looks like chopping you in half might be the way to go, want to test it out?
Building this huge maze just to hide from the shackles, I wonder what kind of scaredy-cat goes to such lengths.
He gets up from the throne, stands tall, and leisurely walks down the steps.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: What makes you think you can talk to me that way? Relying on those tattered shackles of yours?

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: Do you really think you can do what she's done to me? Walking all over me, mocking me... believing you're better, seeing me as weak?

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: How dare you!?
Rusted steel rods surge from the earth, coming at you like a storm. "Taran" is knocked away, while the Corpseborne clutches your neck in his grasp.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: My domain is spreading, blanketing the whole Syndicate. Every soul, every person here is my prey. My power is now fully reclaimed.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: From now on, no pit is too deep, no tower too high to confine me. I'll go farther, gain more.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: But first, it's time to settle old scores! You're here first, so you'll be the first to go down!
A burst of blue light spears through its arm and torso, and that's when it spots a small black triangle next to you.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: ...What's this? Shackles? No... it's—
This is top-tier tech from Paradeisos, apparently works a treat on Mania Creation like us.
Got a job to do—use this to kill you. Perfect, it looks like it'll do the trick.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: Kill me, you say? Let's see about that.
